item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 03/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a fresh easterly airstream, the weather will be mainly fine over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be warm during the day. With the northeast monsoon reaching the coast of southern China over the weekend, winds will strengthen from the north over the region. It will be cool in the morning early next week. The northeast monsoon will continue to affect southern China midweek next week.
